lines.t: Wii Sports is Nintendo's best-selling game ever, with over 82 million copies.

sc.label: A REAL WII REMOTE STRAP
sc.credit: Photo: Morgan from Montreal, CC BY 2.0

lines.t: It launched with the Wii in November 2006, and came free in the box almost everywhere except Japan and Korea.
There were five sports: tennis, baseball, bowling, golf, and boxing.
Early on, it starred Mario characters, but players liked their own Miis better.
Nintendo almost didn't bundle it. Reggie Fils-Aime convinced Miyamoto and Iwata.
Players swung so hard that remotes flew out of their hands, so Nintendo made the wrist straps almost twice as thick.
Senior centers even started their own Wii bowling leagues. And it won six BAFTA awards in 2007.
A tough opponent named Matt became a meme, and he came back as a secret boss in Switch Sports.

sc.sub: the meme, now a secret boss

lines.t: In 2023, it joined the World Video Game Hall of Fame.
